description: This file contains unit tests for the Redis-backed implementation of Orleans membership table functionalities, utilizing the Xunit testing framework. The tests validate operations such as reading, inserting, updating, and cleaning up membership entries in Redis.

classes.name: RedisMembershipTableTests
classes.description: Unit test class for testing Redis-based membership table functionalities in Orleans, covering operations like read, insert, update, and cleanup processes.

methods.name: CreateFilters
methods.description: Creates and initializes logger filter options for the tests.

methods.name: CreateMembershipTable
methods.description: Instantiates and returns a RedisMembershipTable configured with connection options for testing membership table operations.

methods.name: CreateGatewayListProvider
methods.description: Creates a RedisGatewayListProvider using the instantiated RedisMembershipTable for testing gateway list provisioning.

methods.name: GetConnectionString
methods.description: Returns the Redis connection string used for tests, provided as a completed task.

methods.name: GetGateways
methods.description: Test method for validating retrieval of gateway addresses from the membership table.

methods.name: ReadAll_EmptyTable
methods.description: Test method for verifying behavior when reading all entries from an empty membership table.

methods.name: InsertRow
methods.description: Test method for inserting a new membership row into the Redis membership table.

methods.name: ReadRow_Insert_Read
methods.description: Test method for inserting a row and then reading it back to verify correctness.

methods.name: ReadAll_Insert_ReadAll
methods.description: Test method for inserting multiple entries and reading all to verify batch retrieval.

methods.name: UpdateRow
methods.description: Test method for updating an existing membership row.

methods.name: UpdateRowInParallel
methods.description: Test for concurrent updates to ensure consistency and correctness under parallel modifications.

methods.name: UpdateIAmAlive
methods.description: Test for updating the 'IAmAlive' status of a membership record.

methods.name: CleanupDefunctSiloEntries
methods.description: Test for cleaning up outdated or dead silo entries from Redis membership table.
